mainEntity.name: How many calories does 10,000 steps burn?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical adult, roughly 300–500 calories, depending mostly on body weight, stride length and pace. Heavier people and faster walkers burn more.

mainEntity.name: Why does walking speed change the calories per step?

acceptedAnswer.text: Faster walking uses more energy per minute (a higher MET) but covers the same steps in less time. Overall, brisk walking burns somewhat more per step than strolling, and uphill walking more again.
For most adults it's roughly 4–5 miles (6.5–8 km), taking about 1.5 hours at a moderate pace — spread over a whole day for most people.
